svg.title: AdaptaMídia proposed AI system design
svg.text: Proposed workflow from display measurements to a campaign report an operator can review
Operators request display insights. Scheduled runs summarize campaign performance.
Check account and unit access, workflow status and token budget. Reserve the run and its evidence cutoff.
Display insight · Campaign digest · Measurement triage · Experiment proposal
Check evidence coverage, delegate one bounded task and validate the result.
The kiosk buffers playback logs during elevator outages. Firebase syncs pending writes when the device reconnects.
Bull and Redis deliver run IDs to workers. Late playback flags an existing report for optional regeneration.
Check before dispatch and model calls
Send aggregate text to the model
Trace run IDs, versions and token usage
Replay measured zeros, skipped captures and late kiosk events. Compare with the baseline, pilot one workflow and review before expansion.
